name: Bernhard Mueller
biography: Bernhard Mueller is an OG security engineer and researcher with experience in a variety of fields including Internet protocols, web apps, operating systems, server software and blockchain technology. His work in mobile and blockchain security has earned him two "Best Research" Pwnie Award nominations (and one win). In the Ethereum community he is known for creating the Mythril symbolic analyzer.
